stem: The controlled record shows a waste container as destroyed, but the identified physical container is still present in the staging area. What is the strongest Technician I response?
choices: Dispose of the container immediately so physical reality matches the record
Change the record back without documenting why
Preserve the container identity and current state, document the physical-versus-record discrepancy, and escalate through the authorized disposition process
Ignore the mismatch because the record is the official source
rationale: Neither the physical state nor the digital record should be forced to match without evidence. The discrepancy must remain reconstructable so the authorized process can determine what occurred and correct the disposition record appropriately.
